title: Benzimidazole-1,2,3-triazole hybrid molecules: synthesis and study of their interaction with G-quadruplex DNA.
authors: Singu, Padma S; Chilakamarthi, Ushasri; Mahadik, Namita S; Keerti, Bhamidipati; Valipenta, Narasimhulu; Mokale, Santosh N; Nagesh, Narayana; Kumbhare, Ravindra M
one_liner_zh: 该文合成苯并咪唑-三唑杂合分子并研究其与G-四链体DNA的相互作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系中的DNA配体结合，但核心为小分子药物设计，仅含简单对接，无TF-DNA或AI/物理模拟方法，匹配度低。
abstract: A series of new benzimidazole-1,2,3-triazole hybrid derivatives have been synthesized via 'click' reaction and evaluated for their in vitro cytotoxicity as well as DNA binding affinity. MTT assay showed that all the six compounds are cytotoxic to PC3 and B16-F10 cancer cell lines. Though all the compounds showed moderate interaction with G4, c-Myc promoter DNA and dsDNA, 4f exhibited selective interaction with G-quadruplex DNA over duplex DNA as demonstrated by spectroscopic experiments like UV-vis spectroscopy, fluorescence spectroscopy, CD spectroscopy, thermal melting and fluorescence lifetime experiments. They also confirm the G-quadruplex DNA stabilizing potential of 4f. Viscosity measurements also confirm that 4f exhibits high G-quadruplex DNA selectivity over duplex DNA. Docking studies supported the spectroscopic observations. Cell cycle analysis showed that 4f induces G(2)/M phase arrest and induces apoptosis. Hence, from these experimental results it is evident that compound 4f may be a G-quadruplex DNA groove binding molecule with anticancer activity.
abstract_zh: 通过“点击”反应合成了一系列新型苯并咪唑-1,2,3-三唑杂合衍生物，并评估了其体外细胞毒性和DNA结合亲和力。MTT实验表明，所有六种化合物对PC3和B16-F10癌细胞系均具有细胞毒性。尽管所有化合物与G4、c-Myc启动子DNA和双链DNA表现出中等程度的相互作用，但4f通过紫外-可见光谱、荧光光谱、圆二色光谱、热熔解和荧光寿命实验等光谱学实验，显示出对G-四链体DNA相对于双链DNA的选择性相互作用。这些实验还证实了4f稳定G-四链体DNA的潜力。粘度测量也确认4f对G-四链体DNA具有高于双链DNA的高选择性。对接研究支持了光谱学观察结果。细胞周期分析显示，4f诱导G(2)/M期阻滞并引发细胞凋亡。因此，从这些实验结果可以明显看出，化合物4f可能是一种具有抗癌活性的G-四链体DNA沟槽结合分子。
